cards.name: One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds
cards.description: It feeds on the “evil” that seeps out during conversations between people.

cards.name: Censored
cards.description: If a flaw in the system disables the censors covering the Abnormality, we will once again have to sincerely consider how to dispose of the manager.

cards.name: 1.76Mhz
cards.description: This is a recording of the day we must never forget.

cards.name: Alriune
cards.description: Bearing the hope to return to dust, it shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live.

cards.name: All-Around Helper
cards.description: Blood covers the whole floor, screams echo, people are running away…

cards.name: Army in Black
cards.description: The color of the human heart is pink, and by wearing the same color, we can blend in with people’s minds.

cards.name: Backward Clock
cards.description: "...Is your future totally grim? Have you hit absolute rock bottom, not a single way out in sight?"

cards.name: You're Bald...
cards.description: You turn on your electric hair clipper...

cards.name: Beauty and the Beast
cards.description: However, the curse continues eternally, never broken.

cards.name: Behavior Adjustment
cards.description: Eventually, intellect loses all meaning as they forget even how to exist.

cards.name: Big and Will be Bad Wolf
cards.short_name: Big and Will be Bad Wolf
cards.description: Still, it didn’t matter to him. After all, he was “destined” to be a big bad wolf.

cards.name: Apocalypse Bird
cards.description: Then, in the middle of all the chaotic cries, someone shouted: “It's the beast! A big, scary monster lives in the black, dusky forest!”

cards.name: Big Bird
cards.description: A month later, we came to this conclusion: There was no such “beast” in the forest.

cards.name: Judgement Bird
cards.description: Its scale would never neglect the weight of even the smallest sin

cards.name: Punishing Bird
cards.description: People have been committing sins since long ago. “Why do they commit sins, knowing it's wrong?"

cards.name: Bloodbath
cards.description: Many hands float in the bath. They are the hands of the people I once loved.

cards.name: Blue Star
cards.description: Let us meet again as stars.

cards.name: The Burrowing Heaven
cards.description: Don't look away, just keep your eyes on it. Contain it in your sight.

cards.name: Child of the Galaxy
cards.description: A teardrop fell from the child's dewy eyes, as stars showered from the sky. The world falls into a slumber, trapped in an ecstatic lullaby.

cards.name: Clouded Monk
cards.description: However, if enough sarira are found from you that everyone looks on in awe, your name will be sung for generations.

cards.name: Crumbling Armor
cards.description: “Life is only granted to those who hold no fear of death.”

cards.name: Der Freischütz
cards.description: "This magical bullet can truly hit anyone, just like you say."

cards.name: Dimensional Refraction Variant
cards.description: The only advice that can be given is to remain cautious and aware of your surroundings.

cards.name: Don't Touch Me
cards.description: You've pressed it numerous times and you still have something you want to know about it?

cards.name: Dream of a Black Swan
cards.description: What happens when the black swan wakes up from dreaming of a white swan?

cards.name: The Dreaming Current
cards.description: Tell the kid today's treat is going to be grape-flavored candy. It's his favorite.

cards.name: Express Train to Hell
cards.description: When the time comes, the train will chug down the tracks and sound its mighty horn.

cards.name: Fairy Festival
cards.description: Everything will be peaceful while you are under the fairies' care.

cards.name: The Firebird
cards.description: Those who succeed in the hunt are granted with one of the very feathers that countless hunters once yearned for.

cards.name: Forsaken Murderer
cards.description: “What's really pitiful is people like you dying to the likes of me.”

cards.name: Fragment of the Universe
cards.description: You see a song in front of you. It's approaching, becoming more colorful by the second.

cards.name: The Funeral of the Dead Butterflies
cards.description: Where does one go when they die?

cards.name: Grave of Cherry Blossoms
cards.description: The more blood it has, the more beautiful it is.

cards.name: The Heart of Aspiration
cards.description: Excessive aspiration would bring about unwarranted frenzy.

cards.name: Il Pianto della Luna
cards.description: Tales say that the moon bewitches man, yet in reality, it is the man that despairs at the moon.

cards.name: The King of Greed
cards.description: “...Sadness says: ‘Begone, pass away!’ But greed seeks eternity—seeks deep, deep eternity.”

cards.name: The Knight of Despair
cards.description: All that remains is the hollow pride of a weathered knight.

cards.name: The Lady Facing the Wall
cards.description: Over time, her unbearable sorrow grew into a mournful obsession, covered in countless, lengthy hairs.

cards.name: Laetitia
cards.description: She was so sad that she had to leave her dear friends behind, so she came up with a brilliant idea!

cards.name: Hammer of Light
cards.description: "$0 [Hammer of Light] is such a simple abnormality. It takes as much it gave to you. What price did you pay to it?"

cards.name: The Little Prince
cards.description: Even if this turns to be a curse, I will love this curse like a blessing.

cards.name: Little Red Riding Hooded Mercenary
cards.description: “I’ll hang his head over my bed. Only then can I get up in the morning without having a nightmare.”

cards.name: Luminous Bracelet
cards.description: This bracelet shall not forgive those who hold greed in their hearts, thus it must only be worn by those in true need.

cards.name: Flesh Idol
cards.description: And the prayer shall inevitably end with the eternal despair of its worshipper.

cards.name: Meat Lantern
cards.description: ...That's not a flower. Order all the employees nearby to evacuate immediately.

cards.name: Melting Love
cards.description: ...and my dear employees, I do hope you all put on the gas masks we distributed to you before we enter.

cards.name: Mirror of Adjustment
cards.description: “The satisfaction is only temporary though.”

cards.name: Mountain of Smiling Bodies
cards.description: The smiling faces are unfamiliar yet sorrowful.

cards.name: The Naked Nest
cards.description: It can enter your body through any aperture.

cards.name: Nameless Fetus
cards.description: "One day you'll understand. The meaning of the desperation on their faces when the roulette spins."

cards.name: Notes from a Crazed Researcher
cards.description: The final chapter ends with the phrase: “Born again.”

cards.name: Nothing There
cards.description: And the many shells cried out one word, "Manager".

cards.name: Old Faith and Promise
cards.description: Those betrayed hearts sank into the depths, slowly forgotten in the ever-lengthening corridors of time.

cards.name: Old Lady
cards.description: She was so talkative before, yet in the end, loneliness was the only listener.

cards.name: Opened Can of WellCheers
cards.description: Somewhere in the distance, you can hear seagulls.

cards.name: Parasite Tree
cards.description: Ease yourself, do you not have need of the blessing?

cards.name: Porccubus
cards.description: Now it's time for my head to burst. Good day.

cards.name: Portrait of Another World
cards.description: This portrait encaptures a moment; it is what we are destined to lose.

cards.name: Ppodae
cards.description: Dude... your “little angel” is gnawing on our colleague’s finger.

cards.name: Price of Silence
cards.description: "Silence is no longer just bringing peace."

cards.name: Queen Bee
cards.description: If you feel an abdominal pain and a tingling sensation in your neck, the best thing you can do now is look at the great blue sky you'll never get to see again.

cards.name: The Queen of Hatred
cards.description: In the name of Love and Justice~ Here comes Magical Girl!

cards.name: The Red Shoes
cards.description: The girl begged in tears. "Mister, please cut off my feet...”

cards.name: Rudolta of the Sleigh
cards.description: With my infinite hatred, I give you this gift.

cards.name: Scarecrow Searching for Wisdom
cards.description: The city still remained a beautiful place where the emerald roads sparkled bright as ever.

cards.name: Schadenfreude
cards.description: Someone's persistent gaze can be felt from the keyhole inside the machine.

cards.name: Scorched Girl
cards.description: I am coming to you. You, who will be reduced to ash like me.

cards.name: Poor Screenwriter's Note
cards.description: "'The sinner was shaken to the bizarre atmosphere of the stage, and confessed his sins. A screenplay is what makes people more honest'"

cards.name: Shelter from the 27th of March
cards.description: It literally makes itself into “the safest place on Earth.”

cards.name: The Silent Orchestra
cards.description: From break and ruin, the most beautiful performance begins.

cards.name: Singing Machine
cards.description: But nothing could compare to the music it makes when it eats a human.”

cards.name: Skin Prophecy
cards.description: Save us now and forevermore. The truth shall set us free.

cards.name: The Snow Queen
cards.description: “The snow is steadily melting... Perhaps because spring is coming, or it might be the palace collapsing.”

cards.name: Snow White's Apple
cards.description: The day a ripe apple fell off the tree in the garden where the princess and the king stood, the witch's heart shattered.

cards.name: Spider Bud
cards.description: Unsurprisingly, not a single employee volunteered to retrieve the corpse of their cocooned colleague.

cards.name: Happy Teddy Bear
cards.description: Its memories began with a warm hug.

cards.name: Theresia
cards.description: “Do you remember this melody? The professor used to play this song when the students were sleepy. Happy birthday.”

cards.name: Today's Shy Look
cards.description: It's a good day! Are you still shy today?

cards.name: Standard Training-Dummy Rabbit
cards.description: An Abnormality in the shape of a training dummy used to train up-and-coming managers.

cards.name: Giant Tree Sap
cards.description: “The tree simply reaped from what it sowed.”

cards.name: Void Dream
cards.description: Please, eat my dreams.

cards.name: Warm-hearted Woodsman
cards.description: This is a forest full of hearts. No matter how many he cuts down, the forest still remains dense.

cards.name: We Can Change Anything
cards.description: Now everything will be just fine.

cards.name: Plague Doctor
cards.description: “I shall heal you, curing you of all disease and injury you possess.”

cards.name: WhiteNight
cards.description: “Rise, my servants. Rise and serve me.”

cards.name: Yang
cards.description: However, the world is more than simply warmth and light.

cards.name: Yin
cards.description: Now you become the sky, and I the land.

cards.name: You Must Be Happy
cards.description: Many of those who underwent an operation inside the machine have found themselves rested and healthy again.

cards.name: Servent of Wrath
cards.description: The Servant was betrayed after abandoning her principles and ingenuously trusting someone with her whole heart. Now, she is dominated by the anger towards herself for what she had done.

cards.name: Pinocchio
cards.description: People lie all the time. Why is that a bad thing?

cards.name: The Adult Who Tells Lies
cards.description: Poor Ozma. She didn’t know that lying adults don’t approach others without reason.

cards.name: Ozma
cards.description: Ozma held the pumpkin-carving knife, then took off running towards where the lady wizard should be.

cards.name: The Jester of Nihil
cards.description: The jester retraced the steps of a path everybody would’ve taken. The jester always found itself at the end of that road. There was no way to know if they had gathered to become the jester, or if the jester had come to resemble them.

cards.name: Nosferatu
cards.description: …And the thirst would never truly be quenched.

cards.name: The Road Home
cards.description: Let’s walk together. To a wonderful land… The world of dreams.

cards.name: Scaredy Cat
cards.description: Can I follow you forever? So I can tear them apart…

cards.name: Silent Girl
cards.description: The girl remains silent. She would simply glare at the core of one’s inner side with her deep eyes.
